translations.answer: The original post compared the hfield/plane and margin>0/margin=0; only the hfield positive margin combination showed jumping. The MuJoCo collaborators confirmed that positive margin overall support was poor and in progress. Therefore, in the corresponding version, this contact parameter ablation should be done first, not directly attributing the jumping to WBC. The thread remains without a formal fix.
translations.applicability: MuJoCo 3.1.6/3.2.0 hfield positive-margin contact; other versions need retesting.
